title: Child recall: decay on primary molars, sealants on first molars

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Hi Emma! Did you score a goal at soccer this week?

transcript.speaker: PARENT
transcript.text: She won't stop talking about it.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Let's count those teeth. Okay, letter K has a cavity on the distal and occlusal.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: And letter T has a small cavity on the occlusal.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Her six-year molars are in. I'd like to put sealants on number three and number fourteen today.

transcript.speaker: HYGIENIST
transcript.text: Sealants placed on three and fourteen. Doing fluoride varnish now.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Let's schedule fillings for K and T in the next couple of weeks.
